name: Nameslop-Benchmark
description:
Nameslop Benchmark
	

The nameslop benchmark prompts a model with the opening of a story and has it generate the first token of the name of a character. The idea is that models which result in a flatter distribution of tokens are more creative. This tool measures that skewness by summing the probabilities of the top 10 tokens.
Currently the script only is targeting base models since it uses the completion API. Instruct model support might come later.

	
		
	
	
		Installing
	

Run pip… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/treehugg3/Nameslop-Benchmark.
evaluation_method: top_k_probability_mass (sum of probabilities of top-10 tokens)
reputation: Niche benchmark hosted on Hugging Face, used primarily for research into generation diversity and name creativity rather than widespread evaluation of mainstream models.
